files.file: test_real_paths_untouched now compares a stat-only snapshot (names, sizes, mtime_ns) of real logs.db and uploads/ taken at import vs now; added session autouse guard fixture repeating the check after the last test.

tests.test: Full suite: 101 passed. Real-path snapshot unchanged.

commands_run.command: cd backend && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ../.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests

design_decisions.decision: Snapshot metadata only (no content reads) and compare; rejected asserting uploads/ is empty, which fails with the user's own files.
Added session-scoped autouse finalizer so the check also runs after all tests, not only mid-run.

implementation.self_critique: Snapshot is taken at import, so pre-collection changes are not seen; mtime granularity could theoretically miss an identical-size rewrite within the same tick, unlikely.
